newsitem.title: UK: BFI up 10 points as Panamxes firm further.
newsitem.headline: BFI up 10 points as Panamxes firm further.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was up 10 points at 1,044 points on Wednesday as brokers reported firm conditions for Panamaxes in the Pacific with rates for modern Panamaxes now at $8,000 daily or more for Pacific or Australian rounds.

Firm conditons also prevailed for modern Panamaxes in the US Gulf with $20.50 no combination reported to have been bid this morning for 54,000 heavy grain USGulf to Japan for first half Novemebr, brokers said
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was little changed in a tunrover of 91 lots.
